title: The Landstar Link, Summer 2026
summary: Award winners, leadership insights, member spotlights, and savings opportunities—explore what's new in the latest issue of The Landstar Link.
body_markdown:
The Summer 2026 edition of The Landstar Link newsletter is now available!


From the headlines in this issue:


- Highlights and award winners from Landstar's 2026 BCO All-Star Celebration
- Q&A with Vice President and Chief Information Officer Rick Coro
- Agent and BCO spotlights
- FleetPride® savings opportunities through LCAPP


Do you have a story idea we should know about? For consideration, email details tolandstarcorpcomm@landstar.com .
